verses.text: Iri ni ijambo Uhoraho yatumye kuri Mika w’i Moresheti ku ngoma ya Yotamu n’iya Ahazi hamwe n’iya Hezekiya, abami b’i Buyuda, ngo avuge ivyo yeretswe kuri Samariya na Yerusalemu.
Nimwumve, yemwe mahanga, nimwumve mwese; umviriza, ewe wa si we hamwe na mwebwe mwese abayibako, Uhoraho Nyeninganji ariko arabagiriza, Uhoraho avuga ari mu rusengero rwiwe rwera.
Raba, Uhoraho ariko araza ava iwe; aramanutse aza kandi agendagenda ku dutwe tw’isi.
Imisozi ishongera musi y’ibirenge vyiwe n’ibiyaya birasadaguritse, nk’ishashara ihuye n’umuriro, nk’amazi atemba ahamanuka.

Ivyo vyose ni kubera ukugabitanya kwa Yakobo, kubera ivyaha vy’ab’inzu y’Abisirayeli. Icaha ca Yakobo ni ikihe? Mbega si Samariya? Ikibanza co gusengeramwo ibigirwamana co ku mpinga z’umusozi ca Yuda ni ikihe? Mbega si Yerusalemu?
“Nuko rero nzohindura Samariya habe ikigunguzi c’umusaka, ahantu ho kurima imizabibu. Nzotembagariza amabuye yaho mu mwonga amatanguriro yaho ndayasige agaragara.

Ibigirwamana vyaho vyose bizomenagurwa; amashikanwa y’ingoro zaho azotongorwa n’umuriro; nzosambura ibishushanyo vyaho vyose. Kuko vyavuye mu mashikanwa y’ingero z’abamaraya, bizokwongera gukoreshwa kandi nk’ingero z’abamaraya.”
Kubera ivyo nzorira mboroge; ngende gusa kandi ata birato nambaye. Nzobweja nk’imbwebwe kandi nzokwabira nk’inyanana.
Kuko igikomere ca Samariya kidakira; carandagase gishika n’i Buyuda. Cashitse no kw’irembo ry’abantu banje, mbere n’i Yerusalemu ubwaho.
Ntimubibwire abansi b’i Gati; ntimurire na gatoya. Yemwe bantu b’i Beti-Leyafura, nimwikumbagaze mu mukungugu.
Nimurengane muri ubusa mumaramaye, yemwe ababa i Shafiri. Ababa i Zanani ntibazosohoka. Beti-Ezeli bari mu kigandaro; ntihakigukingira.
Ababa i Maroti bari mu gatengo, barindiriye ugutezurirwa, kuko ikiza cavuye k’ Uhoraho , kigashika no kw’irembo ry’i Yerusalemu.
Yemwe ababa i Lakishi, nimubohere amafarasi anyaruka ku mikogote. Ni mwebwe mwatumye, umukobwa w’i Siyoni acumura kuko ibigabitanyo vya Isirayeli vyabonetse muri wewe.
Nuko rero muzosezera Moresheti-Gati. Igisagara c’i Akizibu kizoba ivyizigiro vy’uruhendo ku bami ba Isirayeli.
Nzozana uwuzobigarurira yemwe ababa i Maresha. Abanyacubahiro bo muri Isirayeli bazohungira muri Adulamu.
Nimwimoshe inkomvorera mugandare kuko abana munezerererwa bafashwe; imitwe yanyu imere nk’iy’ikinyamwanira, kuko bazovanwa muri mwebwe bajanwe ari inyagano.
Baragowe abategura imigambi y’inabi, bakiyumvirira ku buriri bwabo imigambi yo gukora ikibi! Bukeye, bakayishira mu ngiro, kuko babifitiye ubushobozi.
Bipfuza amatongo maze bakayiha ku nguvu, n’amazu, bagaca bayanyaga. Banyaga abantu amazu yabo, bakabiba ivyo barazwe.
Nuko rero, Uhoraho avuze ati: “Ndiko ndategura ivyago ku bw’aba bantu, ivyo mudashobora kwikiza. Ntimuzosubira kugendana ubwibone, kuko kizoba ari igihe c’amakuba.

Kuri uwo musi abansi banyu bazobatwenga; bazobaririmbira iyi ndirimbo y’agacurantimba bati: ‘Turaherengeteye; ishamvu y’ubwoko bwanje igabuwemwo ibice. Ehe arayinyatse! Ayihaye abatujanye nk’inyagano.’ ”
Nuko rero ntuzoronka n’umwe mw’ikoraniro ry’Uhoraho, wo kugorora umugozi mu gihe co kugabanganya igihugu mu mashamvu.
Ba kamenyi babo bavuga ngo: “Ntuvugishwe! Ntuvugishwe kuri ivyo; kuko ivyago ntibizodushikako.”
Yemwe abakomoka kuri Yakobo, mbega mwovuga ngo: “ Uhoraho vyamunaniye kwihangana? Mbega yokora ikintu nk’ico?” Mbega amajambo yanje ntagirira neza abagenda batunganye?
Ariko ubu nyene abantu banje barahagurutse bahagurutse kurya kw’umwansi. Mwambura amakoti abantu birenganira ata co binona, mukabateza umubabaro nk’uw’umuntu agarutse avuye ku rugamba.
Musohora abagore bo mu bantu banje mukabakura mu mazu yabo bakunda. Mukaka umugisha wanje abana babo ibihe vyose.
Haguruka, genda! Kuko ngaha ata buruhukiro bwanyu buriho, kubera yuko hahumanye, harasambutse, ku buryo hatakivurwa.
Haje umubeshi kandi w’umusukanyi akababwira ati: “Ngomba mvugishwe ko muzoronka umuvinyu n’inzoga nyinshi,” uwo ni we muvugishwa aba bantu boshima!

“Umusi umwe yewe Yakobo, nzosubira kubegeraniriza hamwe mwese; ni ukuri nzokwegeranya amasigarira yose y’Abisirayeli. Nzobazana ndabashire hamwe nk’intama mu ruhongore, nk’umukuku uri aho urisha; aha hantu hazosubira kwuzura uruja n’uruza rw’abantu.
Uwubacira icanzo azoduga ari imbere yabo; bazomena irembo ry’abansi basohoke. Umwami wabo azobaja imbere mu gusohoka. Uhoraho ubwiwe ni we azobarongora.”
Maze ndavuga nti: “Nimwumve yemwe batware bo mu ba Yakobo, yemwe barongozi b’Abisirayeli. Mbega ntimwokwitaho guca imanza zibereye,
mwebwe mwanka ivyiza mugakunda ibibi; yemwe ababaga abantu banje mukabakurako urusato n’inyama mukazikura ku magufa yabo;
yemwe abarya inyama z’abantu banje, mubakurako urusato mukavunagura amagufa yabo; mukabahimbagura mubakurako inyama muteka mu tubehe, hamwe n’izo muteka mu nkono.”
Maze mu nyuma mugatakambira Uhoraho , mutewe n’ivyago ariko ntabishure. Muri ico gihe azobahisha mu nyonga hiwe kubera ibibi mwakoze.
Uku ni ko Uhoraho avuze: “Nk’uko biri kuri ba kamenyi bazimiza abantu banje, bavuga ‘amahoro’ iyo bafise ico barya, ariko bagategura intambara yo kugwanya umuntu wese yanse kubaha ivyo barya.
Ni co gituma ijoro rizobazako, ntihagire ico mwerekwa, n’umwijima, ntimugire ico muragura. Izuba rizocokerera kuri abo bavugishwa, kandi buzobirirako.
Ba kamenyi bazomaramara n’abaragura bazoteterwa. Bose bazokwitwikira mu maso, kuko ata kwishurwa kuvuye ku Mana.”
Ariko jeho, nuzuye inkomezi, nuzuye Mpwemu w’ Uhoraho , nuzuye uguca imanza zibereye n’ubuhizi, ngo menyeshe aba Yakobo ibigabitanyo vyabo, n’Abisirayeli icaha cabo.
Nimwumve, yemwe batware bo mu ba Yakobo, yemwe abaganza abandi bo mu Bisirayeli, mwanka imanza zibereye, ivy’ukuri mukabinyikiza.
Siyoni muhubakisha gusesa amaraso, Yerusalemu mukahubakisha gukora ibibi.

Abatware baho baca imanza bariye ibiturire, abaherezi baho bigishiriza kuronka inyungu, kandi abavugishwa baho baragurira kuronka amahera. Ariko bakarondera Uhoraho ngo abashigikire bavuga bati: “Mbega Uhoraho ntari muri twebwe? Nta cago kizodushikako.”
Ni co gituma kubera mwebwe, Siyoni hazorimwa hamere nk’umurima, Yerusalemu hazoba ikigunguzi c’isakamburira, umusozi wubatsweko Ingoro na wo uzomerako ibisaka.
Mu misi y’iherezo umusozi uriko ingoro y’ Uhoraho uzoba ushimangiwe nk’umusozi usumba iyindi yose; uzoshirwa hejuru usumbe udusozi twose; kandi amoko azohondogana aja kuri wo.

Amahanga menshi azoza avuge ati: “Nimuze tuduge tuje ku musozi w’ Uhoraho , mu ngoro y’Imana ya Yakobo. Izotwigisha inzira zayo kugira ngo tuzigenderemwo.” Kuko i Siyoni ari ho hazova ivyagezwe, ijambo ry’ Uhoraho rive i Yerusalemu.

Azocira imanza amoko menshi atature amatati hagati y’amahanga akomeye ya kure. Inkota zabo bazozicuramwo amasuka, amacumu yabo bayacuremwo imihoro. Nta hanga rizosubira gutera irindi, kandi ntibazosubira kwiga ivy’intambara.
Umuntu wese azokwicara musi y’umuzabibu wiwe no musi y’umusukoni wiwe, kandi nta n’umwe azobatera ubwoba, kuko Uhoraho Mushoboravyose abivuze.
Naho amoko yose yogendera mw’izina ry’imana zabo, tweho tuzogendera mw’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yacu ibihe bidashira.
“Kuri uwo musi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “nzokoranya ibimuga; nzokoraniriza hamwe abajanywe ari inyagano n’abo nateye umubabaro.
Nzohindura ibimuga bibe amasigarira yanje, n’abirukanywe nzobahindura ihanga rikomeye. Uhoraho azobarongora ari ku musozi Siyoni uhereye uwo musi gushika ibihe bidashira.
Ariko weho, munara w’inderetsi w’umukuku, munara w’ubuhungiro bw’umukobwa w’i Siyoni, uzosubizwa ububasha bwo kuganza kwawe wahoranye; ubwami buzohabwa umukobwa w’i Yerusalemu.”
Ni kuki none uboroga, mbega nta mwami ufise? Umutware wawe yapfuye, ko uburibwe bugufashe nk’umugore ageze kwibaruka?

Babara uboroge, yewe mukobwa w’i Siyoni, nk’umugore ari ku bise, kuko ugiye kuva muri iki gisagara uje kuba mu makambi yo mu gahinga. Muzoja i Babiloni; aho ni ho muzotabarirwa. Aho ni ho Uhoraho azobacungurira abakuye mu maboko y’abansi banyu.
Ariko ubu amoko menshi akoraniye hamwe ngo abagwanye. Bavuga bati: “Reka tuhahumanye, amaso yacu yirabire uburyo Siyoni hasamburwa!”
Ariko bo ntibazi ivyiyumviro vy’ Uhoraho ; ntibatahura imigambi yiwe, ko yabegeranirije hamwe nk’imikama y’ingano ku mbuga.

“Haguruka usekure ingano, mukobwa w’i Siyoni, kuko nzoguha amahembe y’ivyuma; ndaguhe ibinono vy’imiringa, kandi uzojanjagura amoko menshi uyagire ubunywenywe.” Kandi muzogira inyegu y’ Uhoraho ivyo banyaze, ubutunzi bwabo buzoba ubw’Umwami w’isi yose.
Egeranya ingabo zawe, yewe wa gisagara c’ingabo, kuko umwansi akwugarije. Bazokubita umutware wa Isirayeli, bazomukubita inkoni kw’itama.
“Ariko wewe Betelehemu Efurata, naho uri muto mu bisagara vy’umuryango wa Yuda, muri wewe hazomviramwo uwuzoganza Abisirayeli, kandi amamuko yiwe ni aya kera, yamyeho uhereye mu bihe vya kera.”
Nuko rero Abisirayeli bazoba akahebwe kugeza igihe umugore ari ku bise azovyarira umuhungu, n’abasigaye mu bavukanyi biwe bakagaruka bakifatanya n’Abisirayeli.
Azohaguruka aragire umukuku wiwe ari mu nkomezi z’ Uhoraho , mu cubahiro c’izina ry’ Uhoraho Imana yiwe. Maze bazokwibera amahoro, kuko muri ico gihe ubukuru bwiwe buzoshika no ku mpera z’isi.
Kandi ni we azoba amahoro yacu aho Abashuri bazoterera igihugu cacu bakagendagenda mu nzitiro zacu. Tuzohagurutsa abungere indwi bo kubagwanya, mbere ni abagabisha umunani,
bazoganzisha inkota igihugu c’i Ashuri, igihugu ca Nimurodi bakiganzishe inkota isokoye. Azodukiza Abashuri aho bazoterera igihugu cacu bakajabuka imbibe zaco.
Amasigarira y’aba Yakobo azoba hagati mu mahanga menshi nk’urume ruvuye k’ Uhoraho , nk’imvura iguye ku vyatsi, itarinda kurindira umuntu n’umwe canke ngo igire umuntu ayitegeka.

Amasigarira y’aba Yakobo azoba mu moko menshi, hagati mu mahanga menshi, nk’intambwe mu bikoko vyo mw’ishamba, nk’umugunza w’intambwe mu mikuku y’intama, iyo irenganye itabagura yongera isiribanga, ata muntu wo gutabara.
Ukuboko kwawe kuzoshirwa hejuru ngo kuneshe abansi bawe, kandi abakugwanya bazoherengetera.
“Kuri uwo musi,” ni ko Uhoraho avuze, “Nzoherengeteza amafarasi hagati muri mwebwe nsambure imikogote yawe.
Nzosambura ibisagara vyo mu gihugu cawe nsenyurire hasi inzitiro zawe.
Nzoherengeteza ubupfumu bwawe kandi ntuzosubira kuragura.
Nzoherengeteza ibigirwamana vyawe n’inkingi z’amabuye zawe nzozikura muri wewe. Ntuzoba ucikubita imbere y’ibikorwa vy’intoke zawe.
Nzorandura muri wewe inkingi za Ashera aho nzosamburira ibisagara vyawe.
Nzokwihorana uburake n’ubushangashirwe amahanga atanyumviye.”
Nimwumve ivyo Uhoraho avuga: “Haguruke, muburane urubanza rwanje imbere y’imisozi; uturambi nitwumve ivyo mugira muvuge.
Nimwumve yemwe misozi, ivyo Uhoraho abagiriza; nimwumvirize, yemwe matanguriro y’isi y’ibihe vyose. Kuko Uhoraho afitaniye urubanza n’abantu biwe; afise ivyo yagiriza Abisirayeli.
Bwoko bwanje, ni igiki nabakoreye? Nabaruhije gute? Nimunyishure.
Nabakuye muri Egiputa kandi narabacunguye ndabakura mu nzu y’ubuja. Narungitse Mose ngo abarongore, hamwe na Aroni na Miriyamu.

Bantu banje, nimwibuke ivyo Balaki umwami w’i Mowabu yari yagabiye n’ivyo Balamu mwene Beyori yishuye. Nimwibuke urugendo rwanyu kuva i Shitimu gushika i Gilugali, kugira ngo mumenye ibikorwa vyo kugororoka vy’ Uhoraho .”
Mbega norengukana iki imbere y’ Uhoraho ngo nuname imbere y’Imana ishizwe hejuru? Mbega norengukana imbere yiwe ibimazi bituriwe, hamwe n’ishuri imaze umwaka umwe?

Mbega Uhoraho anezerwa n’impfizi z’intama ibihumbi, canke n’inzuzi z’amavuta ya elayo ibihumbi cumi? Mbega notanga imfura yanje kw’ikimazi ku bw’icaha canje, icamwa c’umubiri wanje ku bw’icaha c’umutima wanje?
Yewe muntu, yarakweretse iciza ico ari co. Mbega hari ikindi Uhoraho akugombako? Ni ugukora ibigororotse, gukunda imbabazi, no kugendana n’Imana yawe wicishije bugufi.
Nimwumve! Uhoraho ariko arahamagara iki gisagara, kandi kwubaha izina ryiwe ni bwo bwenge. “Nimutinye inkoni n’uwayitumye.
Mbega nzokwirengagiza za nyungu mbi, yemwe ab’inzu y’abanyakibi, na ya minzane yanyu ipima ibidakwiye, navumye?
Mbega nzogenda ntahanye uwukoresha iminzane y’ibinyoma, n’imifuko y’amabuye y’umunzane adakwiye?
Abatunzi banyu bafise umuryano; ababa ngaha ni ababeshi n’indimi zabo zivuga ivyo guhendana.
Kubera ivyo, natanguye kubahonya, ngo muherengetere kubera ivyaha vyanyu.
Muzorya ntimuhage; muzokwama mwumva inda zigaragara. Muzokwegeranya ariko nta co muzoziganya, kuko ivyo muzoziganya nzobimarisha inkota.
Muzobiba ariko ntimuzokwimbura; muzogana imyelayo ariko ntimuzokoresha amavuta yayo, muzogana inzabibu ariko ntimuzonywa umuvinyu wazo.

Mwitondeye ivyagezwe vya Omuri n’ibikorwa vyose vy’inzu ya Ahabu; mwakurikije imigenzo yabo. Ni co gituma nzobarekurirako uguhona abantu banyu na bo ndabarekurireko ibimaramare; muzokwumva agacokoro k’amahanga.”
Ewe jewe ndagowe! Meze nk’uwegeranya ivyamwa mu gihe vyeruye, mu gihe co gutorora mu mizabibu; ata mahando y’inzabibu zo kurya aboneka, ata n’insukoni z’amasega ngo zimpembure.
Abizigirwa baheze mu gihugu; nta mugororotsi n’umwe agisigaye. Umuntu wese abundira kuvisha amaraso; umuntu wese ahiga mugenziwe ngo amute mu mutego.
Ibiganza vyabo vyompi vyamogoreye gukora ibibi; umutware asaba ingero, abacamanza bakira ibiturire. Abahambaye bategekesha agahahazo ngo baronke ivyo bipfuza, kandi bose bahuje umutima.

Umuntu mwiza muri bo ameze nk’umubambangwe, uwurusha abandi ukugororoka arusha ububi uruzitiro rw’amahwa. Umusi wawe wo kugenderwa n’Imana urashitse, umusi abarinzi bawe bazovuza inzamba. Ni igihe cawe co kuzazanirwa.
Ntiwizigire umubanyi; ivyizigiro vyawe ntibibe ku mugenzi. Naho yoba umugore mubumbatirana, wirinde ivyo iminwa yawe ivuga.
Kuko umuhungu ntiyubaha se, n’umukobwa ahagurukiye kugwanya nyina, umukazana akagwanya inabukwe, abansi b’umuntu bakaba abo mu rugo iwe.
Ariko jeho nzokwitega Uhoraho nizigiye, nzororera Imana Umukiza wanje; Imana yanje izonyumva.
Ntunyitambe ku muvyimba, wa mwansi wanje we! Naho naguye, nzovyuka. Naho nicaye mu mwijima, Uhoraho azombera umuco.
Kubera namucumuyeko, nzokwihanganira uburake bw’ Uhoraho , kugeza aho azoburana urubanza rwanje akarutsinda. Azonsohora anshire mu muco; nzobona ukugororoka kwiwe.

Maze umwansi wanje azobibona hanyuma amaramare, umwe yambwira ngo: “Mbega Uhoraho Imana yawe ari hehe?” Amaso yanje azokwibonera ugutemba kwiwe; kandi azosiribangirwa hasi n’ibirenge nk’ivyondo mu nzira.
Umusi wo kwubaka inzitiro zawe urashitse, umusi wo kwagura imbibe zawe.

Kuri uwo musi abantu bazoza bakugana bavuye muri Ashuri no mu bisagara vyo muri Egiputa, mbere kuva muri Egiputa gushika ku ruzi Efurate, no kuva ku kiyaga gushika ku kindi no kuva ku musozi gushika ku wundi.
Isi izohinduka ubweranyange kubera abayibako, bitewe n’ivyo bakoze.
Ragiza abantu bawe inyobozo yawe, umukuku w’ishamvu yawe, wibera ukwawo mw’ishamba, ahantu h’uburagiro hamera. Baragire i Bashani n’i Gileyadi nko mu gihe ca kera.
“Nko mu misi mwava muri Egiputa, nzobereka ibitangaza vyanje.”
Amahanga azobibona amaramare, inkomezi zabo zose zihere. Bazoshira amaboko yabo ku munwa bumirwe.
Bazorigata umukungugu nk’inzoka, nk’ibikoko bikwega inda hasi. Bazosohoka bahinda agashitsi bava mu bibundo vyabo; bazohindukirira Uhoraho Imana yacu bari n’ubwoba kandi bazogutinya.
Ni iyihe Mana imeze nkawe, iharira icaha, ikababarira ibigabitanyo vy’amasigarira y’ishamvu yiwe? Ntiwama uratse ibihe vyose ahubwo uhimbarwa no kugira imbabazi.
Uzosubira kutugirira ikigongwe; uzosiribangira ivyaha vyacu musi y’ibirenge vyawe n’ibigabitanyo vyacu uzobita i bwina mu kiyaga.
Uzoba umwizigirwa ku ba Yakobo, uzokwerekana urukundo kuri Aburahamu, nk’uko wabirahiye ba sogokuruza bacu mu bihe vya kera.
